fact: A World Bank contract award notice (award issued 27 May 2026, 15-month duration) shows the Lesotho Integrated Transport, Trade and Logistics Project procured an upgrade and enhancement of the ASYCUDAWorld system from UNCTAD for USD 1,332,146.
title: Procurement of service to upgrade asycudaworld (aw) system - Contract Award
publisher: World Bank (Lesotho Integrated Transport, Trade and Logistics Project), via BidsFactory
